row:
Aussie swag is about life in Australia as an immigrant, international student, temporary or permanent resident or even as a traveler.  If you are travelling to Australia as an immigrant or as a student then you will find valuable information about Australian lifestyle.
In my videos, I have tried to show the best possible way to help people who are interested in coming to Australia and how a daily life looks like. Moreover, I have my own passion of vlogging and filming, so I just took the camera and started shooting around. 
Australia is a great place to live and work. Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Tasmania and North Queensland are some of the best places to visit and in fact my aim is to travel around Australia and shoot around to share with the world. 
No legal advise is given in any video, you may differ with them as they are my own personal experiences. 
Peace!
